Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style John Portraits
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4500]Custom npc John[/url] mod Character John, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. 

*Make sure you have PyTK mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
Find where you installed your John mod (some where in Stardew Valley\Mods folder)
Drag the "[CP] John" folder from my Zip into the Stardew Valley\Mods folder to overwrite the "[CP] John" folder in it.

This mod replaces the default portrait of John.
If the portraits is not showing, please make sure the folder overwrites the correct files (there are two layers of "[CP] John" folder in the original mod).



Uploaded CP version.
*I would still recommend the replacement file version as the assets don't get loaded 2 times and are lighter to run.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4500]Custom npc John[/url]﻿ mod.)

The characters belong to the creator of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4500]Custom npc John[/url]﻿: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/74479268]fellowclown[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.

Downloads.Description:
Content Patcher version, drag the folder into Stardew Valley\Mods to install.

I would still recommend the replacement file version since the assets won't get loaded 2 times. But if the replacement file don't work for you try this version.

Portraiture version.

*I do not advise using Portraiture to install those portraits since Portraiture doesn't support seasonal outfits, so their seasonal outfits and festival portraits will not work.*
If possible, please try the replacement file instead.
